# 1494 Labs

# Run your fund's books in one system, and stop rebuilding them in spreadsheets.

## What the ledger covers.

### [Partnership and investor accounting](https://1494labs.com/fund-accounting-software/)

- Subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, calls, commitments, distributions and recallable capital.

- Equalization or series accounting, chosen per fund. High-water marks carried per investor through partial redemptions, transfers and restatements.

- Management and incentive fees, offsets, waterfalls with carry, clawback and vesting, and side pockets.

- Allocations by class, series and sleeve, and investor NAV in the class currency.

![Series table, one series per subscription month](https://1494labs.com/assets/screens/series.7f98fbc2.jpg)**One series per subscription month.** Each is issued at 100.00 in its own inception period and measured against its own high-water mark.

### [Complex structures](https://1494labs.com/holding-company-and-family-office-entity-accounting/)

- Master-feeder, alternative investment vehicles (AIVs), SPVs, blockers, co-investments and continuation vehicles.

- Holding companies, family partnerships, trusts and GRATs, SMAs and funds of one, and personal accounts, with ownership traced through every layer.

- Blocker tax accrued at the entity and carried to each investor behind it.

- Fund of funds look-through to the underlying holdings, on both ownership bases.

![Ownership graph of a family structure](https://1494labs.com/assets/screens/structure-graph.60cc35a2.jpg)**Every vehicle once, with its owners converging on it.** A vehicle with several owners appears once, where a set of separate trees would repeat it on every branch.

### [Portfolio accounting across asset classes](https://1494labs.com/portfolio-accounting/)

- Public and private equity, fixed income, loans, credit facilities on both sides, real estate and REITs, derivatives, hedge fund and private fund interests, and digital assets, in any currency.

![Holdings table with each manager at cost and at value](https://1494labs.com/assets/screens/portfolio-holdings.3916f10a.jpg)**Six managers, each at cost and at value.** The date each was last revalued sits on the row, because the age of an input is part of the number.

### [Close, controls and reconciliation](https://1494labs.com/close-controls-and-reconciliation/)

- The trial balance is frozen at close, and later changes are kept beside it with their reason.

- The book as reported at close and the book with everything known since, on one ledger, with the source of every line.

- Cash, positions and NAV reconciled against outside files, with an exceptions worklist.

- A check that recomputes every fund's arithmetic each morning.

![Reconciliation break with expected, actual and difference](https://1494labs.com/assets/screens/break-detail.dc783d42.jpg)**Expected, actual, difference, and a decision with a name on it.** Resolved means the numbers now agree. Accepted means they still differ and somebody decided that is correct, with a note.

### [Reporting](https://1494labs.com/fund-and-investor-reporting/)

- NAV, capital account statements, ILPA notices, performance, and Form PF and Form ADV answers from the same book.

- Saved analyses that refresh on the platform and can be pulled through the API.

![ILPA capital account statement lines for each investor account: beginning NAV, contributions and distributions](https://1494labs.com/assets/screens/ilpa-capital-account.211b6f9c.jpg)**Statement lines for every investor account.** Beginning NAV, contributions and distributions on the ILPA template's own rows, with a check that all statements foot.

### [Getting your documents and data in](https://1494labs.com/fund-accounting-api-and-ai/)

Fund documents are read into records for review, fee and carry terms are read from LPAs and side letters, and spreadsheets and exports are mapped to the book's fields. Forward documents to your workspace's own address for the same reading and review.

- ### [Portfolio companies](https://1494labs.com/portfolio-company-kpi-collection/)

Financials and KPIs collected from each company by upload or a secure submission link, with every submission and correction kept.

- ### [Secondaries](https://1494labs.com/secondaries-and-strip-sale-accounting/)

Buy and sell LP interests, single or as a strip sale across many funds, with price adjustments and deferred payments.

- ### [Liquidity and forecasting](https://1494labs.com/liquidity-forecasting-and-commitment-pacing/)

Cash projection in horizon buckets from settled cash, available liquidity and commitment pacing.

- ### [API and AI](https://1494labs.com/fund-accounting-api-and-ai/)

Everything on screen is also in the public API, and AI assistants read the book through MCP.

The capability matrix lists product scope and status.

## Demo, sandbox and assistant access

- [Request a demo](https://1494labs.com/#contact): describe your fund and current workflow, or email hello@1494labs.com. Ask for a sandbox seeded with reference funds.
- [Capabilities](https://1494labs.com/capabilities.md): current product scope and status.
- [Connect an assistant](https://1494labs.com/connect-assistant.md): endpoint, authentication, tools and a synthetic example.
- MCP: POST /api/v1/mcp on your workspace's application origin. Requires ordinary workspace authentication and respects the user's permissions. Tools read the book and run saved analyses; this is not an anonymous public demo endpoint. Ask hello@1494labs.com about connecting your assistant.

## Pages and worked notes

- [Blocker Corporation Accounting](https://1494labs.com/blocker-corporation-accounting.md): Blocker corporation accounting for managers, allocators and administrators: corporate tax accrued at the entity and carried to each investor behind it.
- [Fund Accounting Capabilities](https://1494labs.com/capabilities.md): Fund, partnership and portfolio accounting for managers, allocators and administrators, with current capability status.
- [Capital Call and Distribution Software](https://1494labs.com/capital-call-and-distribution-software.md): Capital call and distribution software for fund managers, allocators and administrators: notices, unfunded commitments and investor bank details.
- [Close, Controls and Reconciliation](https://1494labs.com/close-controls-and-reconciliation.md): Period close and reconciliation for controllers and administrators: frozen trial balance, graded revisions and reviewed exceptions.
- [1494 Labs vs Allvue Fund Accounting](https://1494labs.com/compare/1494-labs-vs-allvue.md): A fund accounting comparison for a private equity team closing the ledger and investor capital accounts together. Use a worked close to test the fit.
- [1494 Labs vs FIS Private Capital Suite](https://1494labs.com/compare/1494-labs-vs-fis-investran.md): A fund accounting comparison for a private capital team evaluating fund accounting, carry and investor reporting. Use a worked close to test the fit.
- [1494 Labs vs FundCount](https://1494labs.com/compare/1494-labs-vs-fundcount.md): A fund accounting comparison for a family office or fund team keeping investment and investor records together. Use a worked close to test the fit.
- [1494 Labs vs LemonEdge](https://1494labs.com/compare/1494-labs-vs-lemonedge.md): A fund accounting comparison for a fund team working through multi-level ownership and allocation rules. Use a worked close to test the fit.
- [1494 Labs vs SS&C Geneva](https://1494labs.com/compare/1494-labs-vs-ssc-geneva.md): A fund accounting comparison for a hedge fund team reviewing its investment book and investor accounting. Use a worked close to test the fit.
- [An alternative to Allvue: fund accounting with 1494 Labs](https://1494labs.com/compare/allvue-alternative.md): Evaluate 1494 Labs for a private equity team closing the ledger and investor capital accounts together, with ledger traces and a worked acceptance case.
- [An alternative to FIS Private Capital Suite / Investran: fund accounting with 1494 Labs](https://1494labs.com/compare/fis-investran-alternative.md): Evaluate 1494 Labs for a private capital team weighing fund accounting, carry and investor reporting, with ledger traces and a worked acceptance case.
- [An alternative to FundCount: fund accounting with 1494 Labs](https://1494labs.com/compare/fundcount-alternative.md): Evaluate 1494 Labs for a family office or fund team keeping investment and investor records together, with ledger traces and a worked acceptance case.
- [Compare fund accounting software](https://1494labs.com/compare.md): Compare published product scope, then test the accounting with your own fund terms and a worked close.
- [An alternative to LemonEdge: fund accounting with 1494 Labs](https://1494labs.com/compare/lemonedge-alternative.md): Evaluate 1494 Labs for a fund team working through multi-level ownership and allocation rules, with ledger traces and a worked acceptance case.
- [An alternative to SS&C Geneva: fund accounting with 1494 Labs](https://1494labs.com/compare/ssc-geneva-alternative.md): Evaluate 1494 Labs for a hedge fund team reviewing its investment book and investor accounting, with ledger traces and a worked acceptance case.
- [Connect an assistant to your fund accounting workspace](https://1494labs.com/connect-assistant.md): Connect an MCP client to a 1494 Labs workspace: endpoint, authentication, five read-only tools and a synthetic example.
- [Distribution waterfalls configured from the agreement](https://1494labs.com/distribution-waterfall-software.md): Distribution waterfall software for private equity: tiers set from the LPA, carry held as an accrual under a whole-fund test, and clawback exposure per LP.
- [Investment accounting for endowments and foundations](https://1494labs.com/endowment-foundation-accounting.md): Endowment and foundation investment accounting: private fund commitments, dated manager marks, look-through exposure and commitment pacing on one book.
- [Equalization and Series Accounting](https://1494labs.com/equalization-and-series-accounting.md): Equalization and series accounting for hedge funds with investors entering at different dates: class records, NAV and fees.
- [Family office accounting, through every layer of ownership](https://1494labs.com/family-office-accounting.md): Family office accounting for households held through trusts, holding companies and partnerships, with every asset counted once in the family's net worth.
- [Look-through consolidation for family offices](https://1494labs.com/family-office-consolidation.md): Family office consolidation: look through trusts, holding companies and partnerships to what the family owns, with ownership taken from capital accounts.
- [Fund Accounting API and AI](https://1494labs.com/fund-accounting-api-and-ai.md): Connect the fund book to other systems and AI assistants through an API, notice endpoints and read-only tools, for managers, allocators and administrators.
- [Fund, Partnership and Investor Accounting](https://1494labs.com/fund-accounting-software.md): Fund and partnership accounting software for managers, allocators and administrators: fund setup, fees, capital activity, NAV, close and investor statements.
- [1494 Labs and an outsourced fund administrator](https://1494labs.com/fund-accounting-software-vs-administrator.md): Compare the accounting system with the service relationship, and decide which book and reconciliation your team needs to own.
- [1494 Labs vs spreadsheets for fund accounting](https://1494labs.com/fund-accounting-software-vs-spreadsheets.md): Compare a spreadsheet-based fund close with a ledger that traces fees, allocations and investor balances to their entries.
- [Fund Administration Software](https://1494labs.com/fund-administration-software.md): Fund administration software for administrators with many funds on different terms: share classes, fee terms, close sign-off and investor statement runs.
- [Fund and Investor Reporting](https://1494labs.com/fund-and-investor-reporting.md): Fund and investor reporting for managers, allocators and administrators: NAV, trial balance, financial statements, investor statements and report packs.
- [Fund of funds accounting for hedge, private equity and venture programs](https://1494labs.com/fund-of-funds-accounting.md): Fund of funds accounting for hedge, private equity and venture programs: subscriptions, redemptions, gates, commitments, calls, dated marks, look-through.
- [Fund Accounting Glossary](https://1494labs.com/glossary.md): Definitions of fund accounting terms, with related accounting pages and worked notes.
- [Hedge Fund Accounting](https://1494labs.com/hedge-fund-accounting.md): Hedge fund accounting software for CFOs, controllers and administrators: share classes, fee terms, fee accruals, NAV by class and series, investor statements.
- [Holding Company and Family Office Entity Accounting](https://1494labs.com/holding-company-and-family-office-entity-accounting.md): Entity accounting for family office finance teams: holding companies, family partnerships and trusts, with income allocated through recorded ownership.
- [Run your fund's books in one system, and stop rebuilding them in spreadsheets.](https://1494labs.com/index.md): Fund accounting software that keeps capital accounts, fees, waterfalls and look-through in one ledger. Click any figure to see the entries behind it.
- [Liquidity Forecasting and Commitment Pacing](https://1494labs.com/liquidity-forecasting-and-commitment-pacing.md): Liquidity forecasting and commitment pacing for allocators and fund managers: commitments, expected calls and recorded cash flows.
- [A wrong number that agrees with itself](https://1494labs.com/notes/a-wrong-number-that-agrees-with-itself.md): Comparison controls fire only when two things disagree, so a class of error goes uncaught: the roll-forward foots, the statement ties, the figure is wrong.
- [ABOR and IBOR, and why most systems keep them apart](https://1494labs.com/notes/abor-and-ibor.md): The accounting and investment books answer different questions on different clocks. Why they stay apart and how to test a vendor's claim to merge them.
- [Converting from a fund administrator: prove the first close](https://1494labs.com/notes/converting-from-a-fund-administrator.md): Agree the handoff date, reconcile the opening records and reproduce the next fee calculation before accepting the new book.
- [Equalization, and what a mid-period subscriber actually owes](https://1494labs.com/notes/equalization-and-the-mid-period-subscriber.md): One NAV per share cannot be right for two investors who bought at different points relative to the high-water mark. The two ways it breaks, and the fixes.
- [Equalization at conversion: check each subscriber separately](https://1494labs.com/notes/equalization-at-conversion.md): Two investors can hold the same number of shares and need different fee outcomes. Test the imported records investor by investor.
- [American vs European waterfall on the same two deals](https://1494labs.com/notes/european-vs-american-waterfall.md): American and European carry on the same two deals: same fund, same profit, and a six million dollar gap in what the GP holds if the second deal disappoints.
- [High-water-mark acceptance tests before the first live close](https://1494labs.com/notes/high-water-mark-acceptance-tests.md): Use a recovery, a partial redemption and a gain above the mark to check that the fee engine retained the right investor state.
- [High-water marks and the partial redemption](https://1494labs.com/notes/high-water-marks-and-partial-redemptions.md): When an investor redeems half their holding, the loss carried forward against the remaining shares has to fall by half too. It usually does not.
- [Notes](https://1494labs.com/notes.md): Working notes on fund accounting: ABOR and IBOR, waterfalls, equalization, ILPA reporting and period close, for people who must make the numbers defensible.
- [Management fee offsets: reconcile the fee before and after the credit](https://1494labs.com/notes/management-fee-offsets.md): A fee offset is a calculation with a source, a percentage and a period. Keep all three visible, along with any amount carried forward.
- [Moving a fund off spreadsheets: prove the opening book first](https://1494labs.com/notes/moving-a-fund-off-spreadsheets.md): Choose a cutover date, carry the calculation state and run a parallel close. A trial balance alone is not a complete fund conversion.
- [Side pockets: keep the investment and its investors together](https://1494labs.com/notes/side-pockets-and-investor-participation.md): A side pocket needs its own participation record. A later subscriber should not silently acquire an interest in an earlier illiquid investment.
- [What an opening balance has to carry](https://1494labs.com/notes/what-an-opening-balance-has-to-carry.md): Moving a fund to a new system mid-life is usually scoped as loading balances. Balances say where the fund stands; the next period needs more than that.
- [Which columns can be added, and which cannot](https://1494labs.com/notes/which-columns-can-be-added.md): Reporting tools will total any column you point them at. Four classes of column behave differently under grouping, and only one is safe to add.
- [Portfolio Accounting Across Asset Classes](https://1494labs.com/portfolio-accounting.md): Portfolio accounting across asset classes for fund managers, allocators and administrators: dated marks, look-through, exits and statements.
- [Portfolio Company KPI Collection](https://1494labs.com/portfolio-company-kpi-collection.md): Portfolio company financials and KPIs for private equity and venture finance teams, collected by upload or secure link and shown beside each valuation mark.
- [Private Equity Fund Accounting](https://1494labs.com/private-equity-fund-accounting.md): Private equity fund accounting software for managers and administrators: fund terms, waterfalls, call and distribution notices, unfunded commitments, marks.
- [Real estate fund accounting, down to the lease](https://1494labs.com/real-estate-fund-accounting.md): Real estate fund accounting with leases and rent roll, straight-line rent, property-level books, NOI and occupancy, and a valuation basis chosen per fund.
- [Registered fund accounting, from NAV strike to §19(a) notice](https://1494labs.com/registered-fund-accounting.md): Registered fund accounting software for RICs and BDCs: NAV strikes by share class, §19(a) notices from the book, repurchase proration and asset coverage.
- [REIT accounting, with the qualification tests read from the book](https://1494labs.com/reit-accounting-software.md): REIT accounting software: qualification tests, UPREIT operating partnerships and OP units, distribution character and E&P, NAV REIT classes and FFO.
- [Secondaries and Strip Sale Accounting](https://1494labs.com/secondaries-and-strip-sale-accounting.md): Accounting for secondaries managers and administrators buying and selling LP interests, with valuation and reporting for each position.
- [Secondaries for Fund of Funds](https://1494labs.com/secondaries-for-fund-of-funds.md): Continuation vehicles, tenders and LP-interest sales for fund of funds managers and allocators, with reporting on the underlying portfolio.
- [Side Pocket Accounting](https://1494labs.com/side-pocket-accounting.md): Side-pocket accounting for hedge fund managers and administrators: participation by investor, class NAV and investor capital accounts.
- [Waterfall and Carried Interest Accounting](https://1494labs.com/waterfall-and-carried-interest-accounting.md): Waterfall and carried interest accounting for private equity managers and administrators: hurdle, catch-up, accrued carry, clawback and principal vesting.
